takt.bericht.hinweis: The figures show the overall change since the decision, not just its own effect: many things act at once in the policy network.
takt.bericht.kurz.gemischt: {name}, {monate} months later: A mixed balance. Better: {beste}; worse: {schlechteste}.
takt.bericht.kurz.gut: {name}, {monate} months later: It held. Improved most: {beste}.
takt.bericht.kurz.keine: {name}, {monate} months later: Hardly a trace is left; the effect has faded.
takt.bericht.kurz.schwach: {name}, {monate} months later: Nothing moved for the better. Worsened most clearly: {schlechteste}.
takt.bericht.ruhig: None of the observed measures has moved noticeably: the effect has faded or is overlaid by other things.
takt.gegenkraft.hort.text: Political capital that piles up instead of being used partly decays and costs legitimacy: whoever moves nothing for long soon has less to move.
takt.kabinett.konflikt.anlass: {rolle} {name} warns: “{groesse}” stands at {wert}. The cabinet can no longer pass over it; the department demands a hearing and funds.
takt.kabinett.konflikt.mittel.effekt3: Costs 3 political capital, debt +0.1 % of GDP
takt.kabinett.konflikt.mittel.merke: The president gives the department funds for “{groesse}”.
takt.kabinett.konflikt.mittel.text: Costs 3 political capital and about 0.1 % of GDP. The department gets funds and backing; the measure improves noticeably, the budget carries it.
takt.kabinett.konflikt.reihenfolge.merke: The president puts the department off on “{groesse}”.
takt.kabinett.konflikt.reihenfolge.text: Costs nothing. The department waits; the situation stays as it is and the minister remembers.
takt.kabinett.konflikt.ruege.effekt2: The signal of firmness strengthens trust slightly
takt.kabinett.konflikt.ruege.merke: The president reprimands the minister before the cabinet.
takt.kabinett.konflikt.ruege.text: Costs nothing. The minister is pointed to the situation in their own department; it creates discipline and resentment.
takt.kalender.eubericht: Progress report of the EU Commission
takt.kalender.jugendtag: 19 May: Commemoration of Atatürk, Youth and Sports Day
takt.kalender.ovp: The medium-term economic programme (OVP) is presented
takt.kalender.sommerpause: Backlog of bills before the parliament's summer recess
takt.kalender.souveraenitaetstag: 23 April: National Sovereignty and Children's Day
takt.kalender.unesco: The UNESCO World Heritage Committee meets
takt.person.alter.merke: Stayed in office at the president's request.
takt.person.alter.opt.bitten.ausgang: {wer} stays in office for a while.
takt.person.alter.opt.bitten.beschr: Costs 2 capital; the person stays and loyalty grows, but the gap is only postponed.
takt.person.alter.opt.bitten.label: Ask them to stay on
takt.person.alter.opt.verabschieden.ausg: {wer} is sent off with thanks; an acting head takes over.
takt.person.alter.opt.verabschieden.besc: Costs nothing; an acting head takes over and the farewell leaves no resentment.
takt.person.alter.standard: {wer} steps down; without an answer the department is leaderless for a while.
takt.person.alter.text: {wer} lets you know that after many years in office the strength is fading and the time to go has come. The decision is meant kindly, but it is serious.
takt.person.alter.warum: Whoever has served long goes of their own accord at some point. The question is whether the department then runs in good order and who fills the gap.
takt.saison.neuwahlforderung.opt.ablehne: The president rejects the demand; the opposition announces further rallies.
Costs nothing; the camps drift further apart and legitimacy suffers.
A talk with the opposition defuses the dispute somewhat.
Costs 3 capital; eases tension without changing the date.
takt.saison.neuwahlforderung.opt.neuwahl: The president calls the election within sixty days; the campaign begins.
Costs nothing; releases the pressure, but the campaign starts at once and the office is at stake.
Call the election within sixty days
takt.saison.neuwahlforderung.standard: The demand goes unanswered; the opposition reads the silence as an admission.
takt.saison.neuwahlforderung.text: For months your bloc has had no majority and the polls are bad. The opposition is collecting signatures and the call for early elections grows louder in the squares.
takt.saison.neuwahlforderung.warum: A president without a majority cannot be voted out but can be paralysed. Whoever ignores the call for early elections loses legitimacy; whoever grants it risks the office.
takt.saison.saison_inflationsbericht.opt: A confidential talk with the bank's leadership calms things somewhat.
Costs 1 capital; calms quietly and leaves independence untouched.
Seek a talk with the bank's leadership
The president doubts the forecasts; markets grow uneasy.
Costs nothing; markets turn nervous and abroad takes note.
The presidency stands behind the central bank.
Costs nothing; markets read it as support for the course.
takt.saison.saison_inflationsbericht.sta: No word on the report from the presidency; markets read it as distance.
takt.saison.saison_inflationsbericht.tex: The central bank presents its inflation report: forecasts, risks and the question whether it considers its target attainable.
takt.saison.saison_inflationsbericht.war: Markets read the report and your reaction to it: whoever backs the bank backs expectations; whoever attacks it moves them.
takt.saison.saison_jahresbilanz.opt.erfo: The government puts its successes in the foreground.
The success story meets high prices: many take it for window dressing.
Costs 1 capital; helps if everyday life plays along, hurts when inflation is high.
takt.saison.saison_jahresbilanz.opt.nuec: The review also names what went wrong.
Costs nothing; credibility grows, enthusiasm does not.
A sober review that names the weaknesses
takt.saison.saison_jahresbilanz.opt.refo: A reform programme is announced; the expectation is out there.
Costs 3 capital; raises expectations by which you will be judged.
Announce a reform programme for the new year
takt.saison.saison_jahresbilanz.standard: The annual review does not take place; the country notices the silence.
takt.saison.saison_jahresbilanz.text: At the start of the year the press and parliament expect your review: what has been achieved, what was left undone and what comes next.
takt.saison.saison_jahresbilanz.warum: A review sets the yardstick by which the country judges the coming year. Whoever glosses over problems is later measured against the gap between the report and everyday life.
takt.saison.saison_jahresbilanz.zusage: Concrete steps were announced in the reform programme for the new year
takt.saison.saison_jugendtag.opt.program: A programme for training and first jobs is announced.
Costs 3 capital and about 0.1 % of GDP; noticeably lowers youth unemployment.
A youth programme for training and first jobs
takt.saison.saison_jugendtag.opt.rede.au: The president gives his speech without offering anything new.
takt.saison.saison_jugendtag.opt.rede.be: Costs nothing; the young listen politely.
takt.saison.saison_jugendtag.opt.sport.a: New sports facilities and a youth festival are announced.
takt.saison.saison_jugendtag.opt.sport.b: Costs 2 capital and about 0.05 % of GDP; good images, little lasting effect.
takt.saison.saison_jugendtag.opt.sport.l: New sports facilities and a youth festival
takt.saison.saison_jugendtag.standard: The day passes without the president offering the young anything.
takt.saison.saison_jugendtag.text: Stadiums fill and youth groups march. The young look at what the president has in store for them.
takt.saison.saison_jugendtag.titel: 19 May: Commemoration of Atatürk, Youth and Sports Day
takt.saison.saison_jugendtag.warum: Youth unemployment and fear for the future help decide whether the young trust the government; holidays are a moment when this becomes visible.
takt.saison.saison_rechnungshof.opt.auss: The report disappears into the files; distrust grows.
Costs nothing; corruption stays and the report returns as a scandal.
takt.saison.saison_rechnungshof.opt.guta: A counter-opinion challenges the audit court's figures.
Costs 1 capital; buys time, but trust in the judiciary suffers.
takt.saison.saison_rechnungshof.opt.kons: The government reforms procurement; contracts are reviewed.
Costs 2 capital; corruption falls, but contractors are annoyed.
takt.saison.saison_rechnungshof.standard: The report goes unanswered; the press notices.
takt.saison.saison_rechnungshof.text: The audit court presents its report on public procurement: contracts without competition, inflated prices, gaps in oversight.
takt.saison.saison_rechnungshof.warum: The report lies on the table whether you read it or not. Whoever sits it out gets it back later as a scandal.
takt.saison.saison_sommerpause.opt.orden: Costs nothing; what does not come up waits.
Let the votes run as planned
takt.saison.saison_sommerpause.opt.sonde: A special session brings the open bills to a vote before the recess.
Costs 3 capital; all open bills come to a vote within days, the opposition speaks of railroading.
Call a special session before the recess
takt.saison.saison_sommerpause.opt.verta: The open bills are postponed until autumn.
Costs nothing; reforms wait and the country sees standstill.
Postpone all open bills until autumn
takt.saison.saison_sommerpause.standard: The dispute over the order stays unsettled; the votes run as planned.
takt.saison.saison_sommerpause.text: Parliament soon breaks for the summer, and several bills are still waiting for a vote. The groups are pressing for a decision.
takt.saison.saison_sommerpause.titel: Backlog of bills before the summer recess
takt.saison.saison_sommerpause.warum: What is not voted on before the recess waits until autumn; what is voted on in haste is read in the press as railroading.
takt.saison.saison_souveraenitaetstag.op: The speech invokes the unity of the nation; the country splits into approval and distance.
Costs nothing; nationalists cheer, minorities feel excluded.
A speech on the unity of the nation
The president speaks to the children and puts education at the centre.
Costs 1 capital; the young listen, teachers expect action.
A speech to the children, with a pledge on education
A plain address without points of dispute.
Costs nothing; little effect, little to attack.
takt.saison.saison_souveraenitaetstag.st: The day passes without a speech by the president; the gap is noticed.
takt.saison.saison_souveraenitaetstag.te: The country marks the anniversary of the first National Assembly, and its children. It expects a speech from you.
takt.saison.saison_souveraenitaetstag.ti: 23 April: National Sovereignty and Children's Day
takt.saison.saison_souveraenitaetstag.wa: Commemorations are small stages: the tone and focus of the speech say for whom the president speaks.
takt.var.haushaltsjahr.defizit.sparpaket: The draft contains a savings course.
Costs 2 capital; the deficit falls by about 0.4 % of GDP, employees and ministries grumble, markets breathe easier.
Anchor a savings course in the draft
takt.var.haushaltsjahr.defizit.text: The deficit stands at {defizit} % of GDP: markets and the finance ministry demand a savings course, the line ministries ask for more money.
takt.var.haushaltsjahr.wahljahr.text: There is an election next year: groups and associations press for benefits in the budget.
takt.var.haushaltsjahr.wahljahr.wahlgesc: The draft contains benefits for the election year.
Costs 2 capital and about 0.3 % of GDP; support among pensioners and employees, distrust among markets.
takt.var.mindestlohn.rezession.entlasten: Firms are relieved of contributions, the minimum wage stays.
Costs 2 capital and about 0.15 % of GDP; jobs and firms gain, the budget carries it.
Hold the minimum wage and relieve firms of contributions
takt.var.mindestlohn.rezession.halten.au: The minimum wage stays unchanged during the crisis.
takt.var.mindestlohn.rezession.halten.be: Costs 1 capital; protects firms, real incomes fall slightly.
takt.var.mindestlohn.rezession.halten.la: Hold the minimum wage, do not raise it
takt.var.mindestlohn.rezession.text: The minimum wage commission decides at the end of the year what applies from January. The economy is weak (growth {wachstum} %, unemployment {arbeitslos} %): the unions want to protect the minimum wage, the employers demand relief before jobs are lost.
The minimum wage rises despite the crisis; firms warn of layoffs.
Costs 3 capital; employees gain, unemployment rises.
takt.var.mindestlohn.rezession.warum: In a crisis the minimum wage affects two groups in opposite ways: whoever has work needs the protection, whoever seeks it needs firms that can afford to hire.
takt.var.mindestlohn.ruhe.aussetzen.ausg: The minimum wage stays unchanged this year.
takt.var.mindestlohn.ruhe.aussetzen.besc: Costs nothing; firms breathe easier, unions do not.
takt.var.mindestlohn.ruhe.reallohn.ausga: The minimum wage rises above inflation.
takt.var.mindestlohn.ruhe.reallohn.besch: Costs 2 capital; employees gain noticeably, small firms carry the burden.
takt.var.mindestlohn.ruhe.reallohn.label: Push through a real increase in real wages
takt.var.mindestlohn.ruhe.stabil.ausgang: The minimum wage grows in line with inflation.
takt.var.mindestlohn.ruhe.stabil.beschr: Costs 1 capital; a compromise without a fight.
takt.var.mindestlohn.ruhe.stabil.label: Raise it cautiously
takt.var.mindestlohn.ruhe.text: The minimum wage commission decides at the end of the year what applies from January. Inflation is low at {inflation} %, the economy grows by {wachstum} %. The unions demand a share of the upswing, the employers warn of perverse incentives.
takt.var.mindestlohn.ruhe.warum: In calm years the minimum wage is a question of distribution: whoever raises it now shares the upswing; whoever hesitates gives away support among employees without much relief for firms.
takt.kalender.haushalt: Budget draft for {jahr} from Finance Minister
takt.kalender.mindestlohn: Minimum wage for {jahr} to be determined
